# Rebecca 1.9.1

Rebecca 1.9.1 is a small maintenance release that tightens how user config and VPN profile settings are copied while links are built. It has no database changes.

## Reliability and compatibility

- Settings maps built for share links, OpenVPN profiles and WireGuard profiles are sized from the stored settings only. Output is unchanged.

## Upgrade notes

> This release changes no database schema. The database stays at schema version 68 and no migration runs. Install Rebecca Node 1.8.0 with this release.
